definitions.gloss: Nagatsuki; ninth month of the lunar calendar; September
definitions.explanation: The traditional name of the ninth month of the old lunar calendar, now used poetically for September.

examples.japanese: {長月|ながつき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{九月|くがつ}→九月：00646_kugatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長月|ながつき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote Nagatsuki as the month in the letter's date.

examples.japanese: {長月|ながつき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{夜|よ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧「{夜長月|よながづき}」⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{説|せつ}→説：00360_setsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: One theory says the name Nagatsuki comes from yonagazuki, the month when nights grow long.

notes:
One of the twelve traditional month names ({和風月名|わふうげつめい}).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{睦月|むつき}→睦月：18674_mutsuki⟧: the first month (January)
- ⟦{葉月|はづき}→葉月：22859_hazuki⟧: the eighth month (August)
- ⟦{神無月|かんなづき}→神無月：20362_kannazuki⟧: the tenth month (October)

USAGE:
Seen in letters, haiku, calendars and shop names; in ordinary speech people say ⟦{九月|くがつ}→九月：00646_kugatsu⟧.
